name: Giant Spider

source.note: The 2024 Giant Spider. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against SRD 5.2.1 or the book. Unsure: the Bite's Poison damage and the Web's save. Web is text only (the engine has no restraint that lasts until a web is broken).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs difficult surfaces, even upside down on ceilings, with no ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.summary: Webs don't slow it, and it feels anything touching its webs.

actions.name: Web
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. DC 13 Dex save by a creature within 60 ft or Restrained by webbing until it is broken.
actions.text: The webbing has AC 10 and 5 Hit Points, is vulnerable to Fire and immune to Bludgeoning, Poison and Psychic damage. Text only for the engine.

summary: A horse-sized hunting spider: climbs walls, binds prey in webs and bites with venom.
